Verify all 91 carriers remain referenced exactly once by bundle Evidence Refs before and after view changes.
Verify all five bundle snapshots, their five Review Result bindings, and the v2-v5 Supersedes chain remain navigable.
Verify default Review view returns only type Review and default Spec view returns only Current/Accepted Spec.
Verify Legacy / History view contains every stop-write type and no production authority depends on its visibility.
Inspect Notion UI for Task database automations/connections and both databases' templates before deleting any field or option.
Re-fetch representative current Task, current Review, accepted Spec, carrier, bundle, and historical Review records after changes.
Independent Reviewer computes the manifest file SHA-256 externally and binds review to exact repository revision.

rollback.before_destructive_field_removal: Restore prior view configurations from this manifest. Current production data sources and rows remain authoritative; no staging or double-write authority is introduced.
rollback.after_view_or_option_change: Freeze further schema writes, restore prior filters/display properties/options from this manifest, re-fetch both data sources, and compare active/archive counts and relation graph.
rollback.historical_evidence: Never delete carrier, bundle, Review Snapshot, Review Result, Review Report, Protocol Event, or Protocol Audit records during cleanup. Preserve failed target state for diagnosis rather than deleting evidence.
